§6Tomb Many Graves§f

§aYou're gonna die. A lot. At least your stuff is safe.§f
When you perish, §9Tomb Many Graves§f places a grave block at your death site holding your entire inventory. §9Shift§f while standing on it to grab your stuff back.

The grave is locked to you, so nobody else can rob it. When you respawn you get a §eDeath Inventory List§f that spawns a particle trail pointing you straight back to your grave.

Items return to their original slots when you reclaim the grave. If a slot is occupied, the grave items take priority and the duplicates drop on the ground. There's even a model of your own head on top of the grave block.

§ePS:§f The grave searches a §e9-block radius§f around your death location to find a safe spot to spawn.
